column1: # Sites the silent-drop guard knows about, with the reason each is
# not a defect. Merged by tools/silent-drop-guard.sh --update;
# the reason column is written by hand and must survive a rewrite.
# Columns: count, shape, file, code, reason.
# Adding a row means writing down why the site does not drop data.
# 'the caller checks' is only a reason if you can name the caller.
# --update never deletes a row carrying a reason. If the scan stops
# finding one it says so and refuses; --drop-stale is the answer.
